verdict_detail: The mechanics are clean (all 12 JSON artifacts parse; every Executor numeric claim independently recomputes from raw-result.json with 0 mismatches; the archive binding 62055d296 is verified at git level; FIX-1/FIX-2/FIX-6/FIX-7 PASS). But the two controls that would make the run a valid transfer-gate measurement do not hold under the frozen ledger: FIX-3's planted-path control passes only under an unamended C_special_MOV formula substitution (ceil(k*log2(p))=22) applied to an embedding-degree-1 endpoint, whereas the frozen v3 formula (ceil(0.886*sqrt(p^k))=1284) gives R_xfer=(9+1284+40)/641.609=2.08 >= 0.7 -> recovered=false -> spec v3 falsification F2 (harness void); FIX-5's null-plant recomputation is not independently verifiable (empty edge_ledger, C_path_recomputed=729 echoes the censorship search count; null gate never ran, R_null=null on all 21 cells). RATE-ISO-1 fails by the letter (fraction 0.0), so success criterion S1 is not met. The Executor's completed_valid claim is SUPPORTED only as a toy-tier density-measurement package for the three fixed fields, NOT as an admissible transfer-gate measurement and NOT as sub-rho/HEUR-ISO-1/safety evidence.

defects.description: C_special_MOV substituted in code (ceil(k*log2(p))=22) without an amendment authorizing a MOV-formula change; repair overlay FIX-4 scopes calibration to the anomalous family only, and the executed planted endpoint is embedding-degree-1 (anomalous_trace_eq_1=false). Under the frozen v3 formula (ceil(0.886*sqrt(p^k))=1284, persisted by the run as mov_modeled_value_before_fix), R_xfer=(9+1284+40)/641.609=2.08 >= 0.7 -> recovered=false -> spec F2 (harness void) fires. Independently recomputed, zero new data.
defects.required_action: Either keep the frozen C_special_MOV formula (control fails -> F2 harness void for sub-rho claims) or obtain an approved amendment that recalibrates C_special with a field-DLP-inclusive cost and re-derives the control on an actually anomalous (trace-1) curve.

defects.description: The recovery certificate is a direct BSGS solve of the instance (solve_by_bsgs_toy = P.discrete_log(Q), wrapper-reverified k*P==Q); no isogeny pullback is ever evaluated ('toy pullback = direct solve; no isogeny evaluation at toy scale' — the run's own note). The planted 2-hop walk returned to the special start (top-level endpoint_j=1416 == start_special_j=1416; inner best record endpoint 480976), and the recovered path [1416->480976] is a 1-hop edge between two special curves. The control would pass on any graph with two adjacent special marks; it does not discriminate transfer capability.
defects.required_action: A genuine certificate-bearing transfer control on a non-special instance with the isogeny pullback actually evaluated (or a declared direct-solve proxy labeled non-transfer).

defects.description: CTRL_NULL_IT_PLANT has edge_ledger=[] (empty) although spec.v3 requires a persisted raw edge ledger for Validator-independent recomputation; C_path_recomputed=729 is the censorship search count echoed, not an independent ledger sum. The null-gate arm never ran on any cell (R_null=null x21), so no discriminator between a real sub-rho signal and a packaging artifact was exercised.
defects.required_action: Require a non-empty raw edge ledger for the plant cell and one live null-gate run on a certificate-bearing sub-0.7 claim.

defects.description: HEUR-ISO-1 unmeasured: all 21 cells censored (censored_fraction=1.0), 0 uncensored H_min samples (KS/TAIL null; requires n>=20), F_hit identically 0.0 (degenerate CDF at rho=0), rate_iso_1_pass=false. No adjudication in either direction.
defects.required_action: Record HEUR-ISO-1 as unmeasured; do not read censored rows as negative evidence.

defects.description: rho_special=0 at 28 bits is a 50,000-class sample estimate (95% CI upper bound ~3/50000 ~ 6e-5), not exact zero; at 20/24 bits exact only for the two chosen primes under the smallest-p rule. The zero licenses a toy-tier upper bound for the fixed fields, not a density law.
defects.required_action: Quote the 28-bit value as a CI-bounded estimate; do not promote to a density law.

defects.description: No dominated_by and no quantitative sota_delta in any deliverable (inventor-protocol Pareto honesty failure). Honest quantification is negative for the transfer idea: rho_special=0 -> expected cost unbounded; for the only family found (k=1 MOV) honest C_special >= 2*sqrt(N*) ~ matched rho so R_xfer >= 1 by construction. Cost model omits sieve/construction cost of the special set and a time-memory tradeoff row.
defects.required_action: State dominated_by and the quantitative sota_delta in every deliverable per inventor protocol.

defects.description: stdout prints wall_budget=7200s while the task declares 10800s wall_clock. Actual wall 1627.45s under both; divergence unexplained.
defects.required_action: Record budget declarations consistently in future runs.

defects.description: Exit code not printed in stdout (inferred 0 from completed_valid + empty stderr); manifest top-level validity null while manifest.result carries completed_valid; stderr 1 byte not 0; implementation/ dir (run_bounded_toy.py, it001_pure.py) is entirely untracked and NOT inside the snapshot — the code that produced the run is not archived in the durable snapshot.
defects.required_action: Archive the implementation code in a snapshot for reproducibility binding.

limitations.text: FIX-3 control failure under the frozen ledger (D-1/D-2) voids sub-rho/transfer-gate interpretation per the frozen contract; no sub-rho claim is made anywhere.
All 21 unplanted curves censored; every R_xfer is a censorship_lower_bound, not a measurement; RATE-ISO-1 fails (fraction 0.0) so S1 is not met.
FIX-6 (deterministic-only declaration) is honored; no expected-cost comparison to matched rho is claimed anywhere — correct and honest.
Validator and Red Team sessions resolved to opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free with review-adversarial not attainable on this backend, recorded honestly and not a basis for the verdict.
